status.description: Transport status: whether this job ran to completion. Use "success" whenever you finished the work you were asked to do, even when you are recommending changes. Reserve the other values for the job itself failing.

verdict.description: Reviewer judgment only. Use "accept" if the work should be accepted as-is and "revise" if it needs changes. A revise verdict still uses status "success", because you completed the review. Implementer jobs use null.

artifactPaths.description: Evidence file paths. Always include this envelope's own path, so a review that changes no files still carries evidence that it ran.

failure.description: Why this job failed to run, or null. Not the place for review findings: a completed review that recommends changes uses status "success" with verdict "revise".
